authorization: 2026-10-27 user: Execute live commercial comparison and establish customer value and general reasoning reliability. This authorizes running available commercial services, not manufacturing a favorable conclusion. External recruitment/messages, EFR and frozen benchmark remain outside this execution.
freeze: Hash exact protocol, cases and evaluator before first prediction. Preserve all attempts. References and implementation are exposed; prospective internal registration is not independent preregistration.

tracks.raw_document: 16 fixed self-contained reasoning probes, default FAR heuristic; intended matched QURI fallacy and Fact Engineering arms require authenticated access. Do not give FAR exclusive formulas or cognitive labels.
tracks.live_retrieval: Four identical natural-language queries sent to each connected Consensus and SciSpace service; target DOI/title are withheld. These are commercial research endpoints, not raw-text argument analyzers. FAR default on the same query is measured separately as an unconfigured discovery control, never ranked as a full configured retrieval competitor.

metrics.retrieval: Report target DOI and normalized full title presence in the returned payload, separate from target accuracy, relevance, evidence support, rank, recall of all relevant papers and general reliability. Unknown rank/payload limits stay unknown. A DOI in an echoed original request cannot match because requests contain no target DOI.
metrics.raw: Actual output status, candidate counts, formal decisive coverage, factual abstention, package replay, measured local wall time; semantic labels remain unadjudicated. No subjective pass conversion from plausible prose.
metrics.customer: Observed actual customer completed tasks, correction counts, active time, financial cost and purchase/retention evidence are required; absent observations are null, never zero or a modeled win.
metrics.cost: Connected-service per-call charge and human labor unknown unless receipts exist; local CPU time is not total customer effort.

limits: Case selection is project-authored and familiar; no population accuracy estimate or statistical independence assumption.
No benchmark can prove unrestricted general reasoning reliability. Report coverage, adverse outcomes and exact tested scope.
No representative customer cohort, independent adjudicators or actual buying evidence is available at registration.
No providers/keys are configured or reused by this protocol; connected commercial tools use their existing app connection. No new charges/purchases/accounts are authorized.
Do not modify accepted core, EFR or frozen #518 inputs.
stopping: Preserve errors, auth blocks and returned outputs. No replacement cases or outcome-driven prompt changes. Follow-up requires a successor freeze.
